name: inspira-link-preview
title: Link Preview
blurb: Link that shows a website or image preview card on hover, with pop-in animation.
description: Wraps a link and displays a preview screenshot on hover. Can fetch live screenshots via microlink.io API or use a static image. Preview card pops in and follows cursor position.
use_when: Rich link previews in documentation, blogs, or social feeds.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; requires hover. External API dependency (microlink.io) may introduce delays.
a11y: Link is keyboard-focusable; preview appears on hover only.
